rationale: Adds WidgetBridge::set_time_source / ScriptedUiSession::set_time_source, an injectable clock for script timers, performance.now() and the requestAnimationFrame timestamp (default steady_clock, so hosts are unchanged; performance.now() origin becomes per bridge), and drives scripted UIs in the development-only pulp-ui-frames-observe from its schedule's host clock (--timer-clock schedule|wall) with a timer fixture and tests, plus an import-design skill note. Generic scripted-UI runtime behavior that Vellum's JS UI runtime inherits (vellum-move ledger M-matrix timer clock); no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
